description: gen schema fails closed when a meta-schema contribution declares a type taking a name a meta-schema-form generated crate spells unqualified: the definition imports the four canonical meta-schema documents and adds a string type named Ref. It vets green (the limit is the generated crate's, not the meta-schema's), and generation exits 1 naming the type, its document, and the reason before anything is emitted; the scratch check proves nothing was written into the output directory. A meta-schema cannot declare a reference type at all, so a declared type is the reachable carrier of this refusal on the meta-schema form

stderr-contains: kdlith: gen schema: the type `Ref` of `shadowed.kdl` has no Rust spelling in a generated crate: it shadows a name the generated crate spells unqualified
